adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [..] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [..] : null` (around the shown hunk). Immediately after, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If neither the event type nor the organizer has a destination calendar, `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, so the optional-chained `push` is a no-op and any collected `teamDestinationCalendars` (from other hosts) are never applied to `evt`, meaning those hosts’ destination calendars are silently ignored by the newly-added collective logic.
